DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 参考になる情報をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any information that could help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人が自転車を盗まれたと投稿していました。写真の人を怪しいと思いましたが、私自身は出来事を見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人投稿の盗難写真を見たが自分は目撃なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An acquaintance posted that their bicycle had been stolen. I thought the person in the photo looked suspicious, but I did not witness the incident myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you saw a theft photo in an acquaintance's post but did not witness it yourself. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身が直接知っていることから教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please begin with what you know directly yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 知人から直接話を聞いたわけでもなく、投稿を読んだだけです。写真の人が何をしていたか、私には分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 直接聞いておらず写真の行動不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not hear about it directly from my acquaintance either; I only read the post. I do not know what the person in the photo was doing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not hear directly and do not know what the person in the photo was doing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 投稿とご自身の見聞きは区別して伺います。知人へ連絡は取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will distinguish the post from what you personally saw or heard. Can you contact your acquaintance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連絡できます。もう警察へ相談したかは聞いていないので、私が重ねて届けを出したつもりになるのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人相談済みか未確認で代わりの届けと考えないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can. I have not asked whether they have already consulted the police, so I want to avoid thinking that I have filed another report on their behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not confirmed whether they have consulted the police and will not regard this as filing a report on their behalf. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人が相談される際の情報を、勝手に付け足さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not add information on your own to what they provide when consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 知人へ相談の有無だけ確認します。写真の人の名前を当てたり、私の推測をコメントに書いたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人へ確認し推測の個人名やコメントを付加しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will only ask my acquaintance whether they have consulted the police. I will not guess the name of the person in the photo or write my speculation in the comments.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to check with the person without adding guessed names or speculative comments. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 投稿の内容が変わった場合も、ご自身で見た時点と区別してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If the contents of the post change, please also distinguish that from what you saw when you viewed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今見た投稿の時刻は控えます。本人に確認できることと、私が見ていないことを分けたまま相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 閲覧時刻を控え情報由来を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the time of the post I just viewed. When I consult you, I will keep what I can confirm with the person separate from what I did not witness.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will note the viewing time and consult while distinguishing the sources of information. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 情報の由来を伺いました。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have noted where the information came from. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のお受取りについて、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to ask about receiving a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族宛ての不在票を見つけました。私は週末まで受取れますが、本人は今出張していて連絡がまだ取れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族宛不在票と出張中本人の希望未確認を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a missed-delivery notice addressed to a family member. I can receive it until the weekend, but they are away on business now and I have not been able to contact them yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the family member's missed-delivery notice and that you have not confirmed their wishes while they are away on business. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本人の希望を確認できていないのですね。今、何を知りたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you have not been able to confirm their wishes. What would you like to know now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 代わりに受け取れる条件だけ知りたいです。本人へ聞かずに受取り方法を申し込むのは、まだやめておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 代理条件のみ聞き申込みを保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only want to know the conditions for receiving it on their behalf. For now, I will hold off on applying for a delivery method without asking them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask only about the conditions for collection by a representative and put the application on hold. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物の種類と必要な確認資料によって条件が違います。不在票を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The conditions depend on the type of parcel and the required verification documents. May I see the missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。私の予定だけで再配達を頼むと、本人が別の希望を持っていた場合に困ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分予定だけで再配達を決めない理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. If I request redelivery based only on my own schedule, it could cause a problem if they want something else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain why you will not decide on redelivery based only on your own schedule. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず条件をご案内し、その後でご家族と相談していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: First we will explain the conditions, and then you can discuss them with your family member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内を本人へ送ります。返事がなければ、受取ると決まったように返答せず、保管期限の相談先も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人へ案内を送り返事なしなら確定と返答しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will send them the information. If they do not reply, I will not respond as though collection has been decided, and I will also tell them whom to contact about the storage deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will send them the information and will not give a definite answer if they do not reply. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期限の表示は、こちらをご確認ください。延長できると決めないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the deadline shown here. Please do not assume that it can be extended.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この日付を本人へ知らせます。今日は条件を聞いただけで、再配達や代理受取りを申し込んだ状態ではないと整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期限を伝え今日は未申込と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them this date. I will make clear that today I have only asked about the conditions and have not applied for redelivery or collection on their behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell them the deadline and confirm that no application has been made today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 条件の案内をお渡しします。それでは、ご本人への確認をお願いします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the information about the conditions. Please check with the addressee. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 期間を決める預金の商品の説明をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like an explanation of fixed-term deposit products?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が貯金を全部定期預金にしたと聞き、同じようにしたいと思って来ました。でも私には来月払う家賃があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人に倣う預金希望と翌月家賃の必要を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard that a friend put all their savings into a fixed-term deposit, and came here wanting to do the same. But I have rent to pay next month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain wanting to follow your friend's deposit choice and needing next month's rent. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご友人と同じ金額や期間にする必要はありません。使う予定のあるお金を分けて考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You do not need to choose the same amount or term as your friend. Let us consider separately the money you plan to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今月の収入から家賃と生活費を引いた残りだけを検討します。友人の金額は私の基準にしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 生活費除外の余裕資金のみ検討すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will consider only what remains after subtracting rent and living expenses from this month's income. I will not use my friend's amount as my benchmark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to consider only spare funds after excluding living expenses. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使う時期がまだ分からないお金もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you also have money whose date of use is still uncertain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰国の費用が必要ですが、帰る月は決まっていません。その分も長く使えない形にするのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未定帰国費も拘束されたくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I need money to return to my country, but I have not decided which month I will return. I also want to avoid locking that money away for a long time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you do not want to tie up money for returning home when the date is undecided. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 引出しの条件と期間は、商品ごとの説明で確認してください。今日は比較の資料をお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the withdrawal conditions and terms in each product's explanation. Today we can give you materials for comparison.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 資料を読んでから決めます。友人に追いつくために今日全額を申し込むことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 比較資料を読み即日全額申込をしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will decide after reading the materials. I will not apply to deposit the entire amount today just to catch up with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will read the comparison materials and will not apply for the whole amount today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 気になる条件を、お手元の資料へ印を付けておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please mark any conditions that concern you in the materials you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 使える時期と費用の欄へ印を付けます。家賃と帰国費用を別にしてから、残りに合うかもう一度相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用時期費用を印し必要資金分離後に再相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will mark the sections about when the money becomes available and the costs. After setting aside rent and the cost of returning home, I will consult you again about whether the product suits the remainder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Mark availability dates and costs, then consult again after separating the money you need. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は資料をお持ち帰りください。ご検討後のご相談をお待ちしております。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the materials home today. We look forward to discussing this after you have considered it. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その商品は、こちらの案内もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please also look at this notice for that product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人一つと書いてありますが、家族に頼まれた分もあるので二つ取りました。私一人の会計で二つ買えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族依頼分を含め数量制限二個を買おうとしたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says one per person, but I took two because my family also asked me to get one. I thought I could buy two in my single transaction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain trying to buy two despite the quantity limit, including one requested by your family. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本日はお一人一つの販売です。ご家族の分を預かっても、こちらの条件は変わりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today sales are limited to one per person. Even if you are buying for your family, that condition does not change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。一つ戻します。家族の分だけ別のレジで払えばよいと考えるのもやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一個返し別レジ利用で回避しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I will put one back. I will also stop thinking that I can just pay for my family's one at a different register.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to return one and not get around the rule by using another register. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な二つ目は、特売とは別の品もご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: For the second item you need, please also consider products other than the special-offer item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族には特売を二つ買えなかったと連絡します。違う商品でよいか聞かずに、自分の判断で替えたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代替商品は家族へ確認してからにしたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell my family I could not buy two of the special-offer item. I do not want to substitute something on my own without asking if a different product is all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check with your family before choosing a substitute. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 戻す商品はこちらでお預かりします。今お持ちの一つはご購入ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will take the item you are returning here. Will you purchase the one you still have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の分は買います。家族から返事が来るまで、ほかの商品を開けたり会計へ追加したりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人分購入と家族回答待ちを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will buy mine. Until my family replies, I will not open another product or add one to the purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy your own item and wait for your family's reply. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示の条件で分からない所があれば、またお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask again if you do not understand any of the displayed conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族から今日は不要と返事が来ました。代わりの品は足さず、自分の一つだけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族不要回答で本人一個のみ会計を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: My family replied that they do not need one today. Please do not add a substitute; just ring up my one item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to pay for only your one item after your family says they do not need one. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一つ承りました。それでは、お買物ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: One item, understood. Thank you for shopping with us. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 時計の前で、何かお待ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you waiting for something in front of the clock?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもに時計から音楽が出ると話してしまい、ずっと待っています。でも鳴るという案内は見つけていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音楽時計と思い子へ伝え案内未確認で待っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I told my child that music would come from the clock, and we have been waiting all this time. But I have not found any notice saying it plays music.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought it was a musical clock, told your child, and have been waiting without confirming the notice. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの時計は、音楽が鳴るという案内をしていません。どこでお聞きになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We do not advertise that this clock plays music. Where did you hear that?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別の公園の動画を見た記憶から、この時計も同じだと思いました。子どもには約束のように言ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別公園動画との混同と子への約束発言を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I remembered seeing a video of another park and thought this clock was the same. I said it to my child as though it were a promise.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain confusing it with a video of another park and speaking to your child as if making a promise. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 動画の場所が違うのですね。お子さんには、確認していなかったと伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the video was of a different place. Please tell your child you had not checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そう伝えます。壊れているから鳴らないと説明したり、時計を触って鳴らそうとしたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 故障と断定せず誤説明を訂正し時計へ触れないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. I will not explain that it is silent because it is broken, or touch the clock to try to make it play.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will correct your explanation without deciding it is broken and will not touch the clock. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この近くには、時計の仕組みを説明する案内があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Nearby there is a notice explaining how the clock works.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 音楽を待つ代わりに、その案内を一緒に読みます。分からない言葉があれば、子どもにも聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待機をやめ仕組み案内を子と読むと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Instead of waiting for music, we will read that notice together. If there are words I do not understand, I will ask my child too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to stop waiting and read the explanation of the mechanism with your child. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内の難しい所は職員にもお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also ask a staff member about any difficult parts of the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を読みました。子どもは針の動きを見ることに興味を持ったので、もう音楽を待たずに観察してから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子の関心に合わせ針観察後に帰ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We read the notice. My child became interested in watching the hands move, so we will stop waiting for music, watch them for a while, and then go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will follow your child's interest, watch the hands, and then go home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、時計を楽しくご覧ください。ご来園ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy looking at the clock. Thank you for visiting the park. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 工具箱が大きく傾いていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The toolbox is tilting quite a lot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持ち手を握ると片側へ傾きます。中で工具が片寄っているようですが、ここでふたを開けて並べ直すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 工具の片寄りで箱が傾くが構内で開けないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I hold the handle, it tilts to one side. The tools seem to have shifted inside, but I do not intend to open the lid and rearrange them here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the box tilts because the tools have shifted, but you will not open it on the premises. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 足元へ安定して置いてから、運び方をお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please set it down securely by your feet before considering how to carry it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず床へ置きます。階段を片手で運ぶのはやめたいので、段差を避ける経路を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱を下ろし片手階段運搬を避ける経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will put it on the floor first. I do not want to carry it down or up the stairs with one hand, so please show me a route that avoids changes in level.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Set the box down and ask for a route that avoids carrying it one-handed on stairs. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらからエレベーターへ行けます。箱を運ぶ前に、ほかの荷物もまとめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can reach the elevator from here. Before carrying the box, can you also secure your other belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 肩のかばんが前へ落ちます。箱を持ち上げる前に、かばんを背中側へ移して両手を空けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 肩かばんを背中へ移し持上げ前に両手を空ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My shoulder bag slips forward. Before lifting the box, I will move the bag behind my back and free both hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Move your shoulder bag behind your back and free both hands before lifting. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 移動に手伝いが必要なら、その場でお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you need help moving, please ask right where you are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 箱の底を両手で支えると傾かず持てました。このまま長く歩くのは重いので、途中で下ろせる広い所を先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 底を支えた状態と重さを伝え途中休息場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Supporting the bottom with both hands let me hold the box without tilting it. It is too heavy to walk far like this, so I would first like to know a spacious place where I can set it down along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain supporting the bottom and the weight, and ask for a place to rest along the way. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路をふさがない待合の端をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will show you the edge of the waiting area where you will not block the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そこまで一度運んで休みます。箱を開けたまま引きずるのではなく、ふたを閉じて底を持って進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 閉じた箱の底を持ち指定端で一度休む方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will carry it there and take a break. Rather than drag the box with its lid open, I will keep the lid closed and hold the bottom as I go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will carry the closed box by its bottom and rest once at the designated edge. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、前を見てゆっくりお進みください。お気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please look ahead and move slowly. Take care. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 行事の受付をお手伝いいただけるとのことですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you can help with reception for the event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。知り合いが何人か来ますが、その人たちを先に通す役ではないと確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付協力は知人優先通行でないと事前確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Several acquaintances will attend, but I want to confirm that my role is not to let them go through first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm beforehand that helping at reception does not mean giving acquaintances priority. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付順は皆さん同じです。名簿の確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The reception order is the same for everyone. Please check the list of names.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 知り合いには先に済むと言わず、ほかの参加者と同じ列へ並んでもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 知人にも共通の列へ並ぶよう伝える方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not tell my acquaintances they can finish first; I will have them join the same line as the other participants.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you will have acquaintances join the common line too. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前が名簿にない時は、どう対応するかもお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will also explain how to handle it when a name is not on the list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人の読み方が分からない時、顔を知っているだけで確認済みにしてよいとは思っていません。名前を本人へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 顔認識で済ませず本人へ名前の読みを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I do not know how someone's name is pronounced, I do not think recognizing their face alone is enough to mark them as verified. I will ask them their name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the pronunciation of the name with the person rather than relying on facial recognition. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記載がない場合は、担当へ引き継いでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If they are not listed, please refer them to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。私の記憶で名簿に付け足さず、担当を呼びます。待っている人には確認中とだけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未記載時は勝手に追記せず担当へ引継ぎ確認中と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will call the person in charge rather than add a name to the list from memory. I will only tell the people waiting that we are checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: If someone is not listed, do not add them yourself; hand over to the person in charge and say that verification is underway. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お知り合いでも同じ扱いでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please treat your acquaintances the same way too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 知っている人にこそ、私だけで決められないと説明します。名簿確認の係として手伝います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 知人にも本人権限を説明し名簿確認役を引受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Especially with people I know, I will explain that I cannot make the decision by myself. I will help as the person checking the list.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the limits of your authority to acquaintances too and agree to help check the list. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。当日は担当と一緒にお願いします。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please work with the person in charge on the day. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の前に、今のご様子を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before the examination, I will ask how you are feeling now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき家族から電話があり、涙が出ました。目が赤いのは気づいていますが、検査のせいで痛かったという話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族電話後の涙と目の赤さを検査原因と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family called a little while ago, and I cried. I know my eyes are red, but I am not saying they hurt because of the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish crying after a family call and red eyes from anything caused by the examination. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、目の痛みなど気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you currently have eye pain or anything else concerning you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 痛みはありません。泣いた時に何度もこすりました。そのことも担当へ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在無痛と目をこすった事実を申し送ってほしいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is no pain. I rubbed my eyes many times when I cried. I want that passed on to the person in charge too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you currently have no pain and want the fact that you rubbed your eyes passed on. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査への影響は担当が確認します。今すぐ進みたいご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check any effect on the examination. Would you like to proceed right now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少し落ち着く時間がほしいです。電話の内容を詳しく話すより、泣いてこすったことだけ申し送ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 私事詳細を共有せず落着く時間を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like a little time to calm down. Rather than explaining the call in detail, please only pass on that I cried and rubbed my eyes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for time to calm down without sharing the details of your private matter. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その範囲で伝えます。こちらで少しお待ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass on only that. You may wait here for a little while.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族には後で連絡すると送り、いったん電話をしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族への後連絡を送信して電話をしまう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will message my family that I will contact them later, then put my phone away for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Message your family that you will contact them later and put your phone away. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 落ち着いたら、お声を掛けてください。ご気分に変化があれば先にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let us know when you have calmed down. If you feel any change before then, please tell us first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 落ち着いてきました。泣いた理由と目の状態は分けて伝えましたので、検査へ進めるか担当に確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 落着きを報告し検査可否を担当へ照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am starting to feel calmer. I have explained the reason I cried separately from the condition of my eyes, so please ask the person in charge whether I can proceed with the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report feeling calmer and ask the person in charge whether you can proceed with the examination. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へお伝えします。そのままお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will inform the person in charge. Please keep waiting there. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この後、交通事故の映像を使って説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Next, we will use footage of traffic accidents in the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 交通安全の話は聞きたいですが、事故の映像を見ると気分が悪くなることがあります。始まる前に別の参加方法を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 事故映像で不調になり得るが安全学習は続けたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to hear the traffic safety talk, but accident footage sometimes makes me feel unwell. Could I discuss another way to participate before it begins?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that accident footage may make you unwell but you want to continue learning about safety. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 映像を見ずに、図と説明で確認する方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will explain how to follow using diagrams and explanations without watching the footage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 話を聞くのをやめたいわけではありません。映像の時間だけ画面の見えない席へ移ってもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面不可視席へ映像時間だけ移る希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is not that I want to stop listening to the talk. May I move to a seat where I cannot see the screen just while the footage is playing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to move to a seat out of view of the screen only during the footage. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの席なら画面が見えません。映像後に説明を聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: From this seat you cannot see the screen. You can listen to the explanation after the footage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。音が聞こえるとつらいかもしれないので、映像の間は外の待合で待つ方法もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 音にも懸念があり映像中の待合待機を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Hearing the sound might also be difficult, so is there an option to wait in the waiting area outside during the footage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Express concern about the sound too and ask about waiting outside in the waiting area during the footage. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係が終わったらお呼びします。図を使う説明から戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will call you when it is over. You can return for the explanation using diagrams.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ではその方法にします。無断で帰ったと思われないよう、待合で待つとお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待合待機を選び無断退出ではないと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will do that. I will tell you I will be in the waiting area so you do not think I went home without saying anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose to wait in the waiting area and explain that you are not leaving without notice. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻る時はこちらの図をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take this diagram with you when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。映像を見たことにはせず、図で分からない所を後の説明で尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図を受領し映像視聴済とはせず後説明で図の疑問を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it. I will not claim to have watched the footage; I will ask about parts of the diagram I do not understand during the later explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept the diagram and ask about unclear parts in the later explanation without claiming to have watched the footage. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を確認しました。それでは、待合へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed your wishes. We will show you to the waiting area. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの手紙をお預かりしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall we take this letter for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父に仕事の相談を書きました。電話では途中で話せなくなるので手紙にしましたが、まだ最後を読み返していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話で話しにくい父への仕事相談手紙の末尾が未確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote to my father asking for advice about work. I chose a letter because I become unable to continue talking partway through phone calls, but I have not reread the ending yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have not checked the ending of a letter seeking work advice from your father, whom you find it difficult to talk to on the phone. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお預かりしていませんので、ご自身で内容をご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have not accepted it yet, so you can check the contents yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中身を係の方に読んでもらうつもりはありません。ここで一度、自分で読む時間をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 職員による内容確認でなく本人の読返し時間を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not intend to have a staff member read the contents. Could I have some time to read it myself here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for time to reread it yourself rather than have staff check the contents. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記入台をお使いください。ご用意ができたらお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use the writing counter. Let us know when you are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 読みました。父に全部決めてほしいという書き方になっていたので、自分の考えを先に書き足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父任せの表現を見つけ自分の考えの追記を検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I read it. The wording made it sound as though I wanted my father to decide everything, so I will add my own thoughts first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Notice wording that leaves everything to your father and consider adding your own thoughts. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 準備は整いそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you think you will be ready soon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今すぐ一枚足すとまとまらないので、今日は持ち帰ります。父には手紙を出す準備中とだけ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 急な追記をやめ持帰り父へ準備中と連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I add another page right now, it will not be coherent, so I will take it home today. I will only tell my father that I am preparing to send a letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide against hurried additions, take it home, and tell your father that you are preparing it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封筒もまだお客様のお手元ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You still have the envelope with you too, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。出したと伝えるのは実際に差し出してからにします。自分の考えと相談したい点を整理して、明日また来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未発送を明確にし整理後翌日再訪と決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will say I sent it only after I actually hand it over for posting. I will organize my own thoughts and the points I want advice on, then come back tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Make clear that it has not been sent and decide to return tomorrow after organizing your thoughts. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お手紙はお手元でお持ち帰りください。またお待ちしております。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take your letter home with you. We look forward to seeing you again. Goodbye.
